thread:
ana: FYI — support ticket where a customer sees a flood of provisional token rows after a burst of short reconnects + a mid-request toolcall. They think they're being charged twice.
tomo: can you paste the snippet/ids? looks like typical reconnect/replay pathology.
ana: minimal trace: ```
[INFO] session=org-78 prefix=0x55a start=2025-06-10T02:11:12Z attempt=0001 event=stream_start
[INFO] attempt=0001 event=tool_call tokens=150
[ERROR] network drop -> client reconnect after 4s
[INFO] attempt=0002 event=stream_resume resume_offset=36 event=tool_call tokens=150 provisional=true
[INFO] ledger wrote provisional entry attempt=0002 tokens=150
[INFO] later: final_ack attempt=0002 confirmed=true
```
li: why do we not see provisional for attempt 0001? if the writer crashed before emitting provisional, ledger never recorded the original. that leaves only the replay provisional which looks like a duplicate until confirmed.
pav: our dedupe currently keys on attempt id. reconnects create new attempts, so ledger gets separate rows. proposal: change dedupe to prefer (session_id + prefix_hash + resume_offset) where session exists, otherwise best-effort (client_ip + start_ts_floor + prefix_hash).
billing-bot: billing-bot: Proposal logged: add ledger columns `provisional_origin` (values: first_attempt|replay|unknown) and `original_attempt_id` to aid exports.
ux-bot: Console UX note: customers interpret provisional as charged. We should show a condensed "confirmed cost" by default, with an opt-in toggle to include provisional. Also add a tooltip: "Provisional rows show in-flight attempts and may be reconciled."
li: telemetry change: emit `reconnect_reason` (network|client_timeout|router_swap), `prior_attempt_seen` (bool), `prior_attempt_provisional_emitted` (bool), and `resume_seq`. This will let us measure how often original attempt didn't emit provisional.
tomo: short-term mitigation idea: router should emit a lightweight provisional event as soon as tool_call is scheduled, not after heavy IO, so both original and replay create provisional rows. then ledger can later reconcile duplicates down to one confirmed charge. downside: more provisional noise until reconciliation.
nana: risk: underbilling if we wait to confirm until reconciliation; customers with real retries might be charged later. keep provisional visible but labeled clearly.
pav: infra task INFRA-2501 created to prototype attempt->session mapping persisted for short TTL (e.g., 2 minutes) so replays can be correlated even across router restarts.
billing-bot: BILL-1150 filed to add ledger tags + export columns, and to add a provisional flag in CSV.
ux-bot: Quick console microcopy: "Provisional: temporary charges recorded for in-flight attempts. Final charges are shown after confirmation. Toggle to view provisional rows."
tomo: implementation plan: 1) small router change to emit early provisional + `original_attempt_hint` if available, 2) ledger accepts `original_attempt_id` and `provisional_origin`, 3) console adds confirmed-only default view + explain link, 4) telemetry to validate heuristics.
li: concern: session_id is client-supplied and missing in some older SDKs. we should simultaneously push an SDK update to add session_id and resume_seq. include migration note.
nana: I'll attach the customer's trace to the support ticket and draft a one-pager for CS about provisional semantics.
pav: pairing volunteers for the PoC? @tomo and @li can take router + telemetry, I'll do the infra store and billing-bot will coordinate ledger changes.
billing-bot: acked. BILL-1150 linked to INFRA-2501.
ux-bot: thanks — i'll design the provisional toggle and an alert rule: emit org-alert when provisional_sum - confirmed_sum > 1000 tokens in 5m.
nana: thanks all. will follow up with RFC and PRs. :rocket:
